blockers: RACE_1: Two servers A/B both GetAsync p:1 before either UpdateAsync claim. A claims sessionOwner=A. B UpdateAsync compares current owner A with expected nil and returns nil. loadProgress returns (nil,false), but join creates default Coins=50/Wave=1 and continues; saveProgress exits on persistAllowed=false. Later active B can play without ever saving. src/ToyWarsServer.server.lua lines 89-125, 573-584, 127-128. Existing tests only join sequentially; no concurrent GetAsync/claim interleaving.

RACE_2: A active with unsaved Coins=300 while stored Coins=200. B joins and unconditionally supersedes A's sessionOwner using stored Coins=200 before A PlayerRemoving save. A's final save is canceled; B starts at 200, so A's earned 100 is lost. Existing six session-fence tests assert B wins but do not protect A's unsaved progress. Official Roblox session-locking guidance requires holding/waiting for prior session final save or bounded recovery, not immediate takeover.

findings.reproduction: Start A and B GetAsync for same UserId at stored v1 coins=200 revision=0 owner=nil; return both reads before either UpdateAsync. A claims tokenA; B callback sees ownerA != expected nil, cancels. B joins with default 50, persistAllowed=false; B earns 500 and leaves; store never receives B progress.
findings.expected: B must not enter normal gameplay with default unsavable data. Use atomic authoritative claim/read or bounded retry/wait, and surface an explicit loading/failure state. Canonical interleaving whole-server regression must fail on this head and pass after fix.

findings.reproduction: A loads stored 200, earns 300 in memory; B joins before A final save and replaces owner. A final save cancels and B begins at stored 200. A's 100 progress is lost even if both save calls succeed/abort as designed.
findings.expected: Do not supersede an active unexpired session before its final save or safe bounded recovery. Test A unsaved→B reconnect→A final save→B restored value, including opposite completion orders; preserve purchases (coins can decrease).

limitations: Static interleaving from actual source; new negative regression not executed in this review; current CI only sequential fixture cases.
No Roblox engine, live DataStore, 2-server, mobile or visual evidence.
